'''Toyouke Shrines''' are shrines dedicated to {{ill|Toyouke-hime|ja|豊受大御神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Toyouke-Ōmikami|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to トヨウケビメ|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q2983724}}.

* {{ill|Toyōke Shrine|ja|豊受神社 (船橋市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Toyouke Shrine (Funabashi)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11633346}} - A shrine in {{ill|Kanasugi|ja|金杉 (船橋市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanasugi, Funabashi|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11647219}}, {{ill|Funabashi|en|Funabashi|qid=Q271417|lt=Funabashi City}}, {{ill|Chiba Prefecture|en|Chiba Prefecture|qid=Q80011|lt=Chiba Prefecture}}.
* {{ill|Toyōke Shrine|ja|豊受神社 (浦安市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Toyouke Shrine (Urayasu)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q119929527}} - A shrine in {{ill|Nekozane|ja|猫実 (浦安市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nekozane, Urayasu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11572009}}, {{ill|Urayasu|en|Urayasu|qid=Q319729|lt=Urayasu City}}, Chiba Prefecture. One of the shrines participating in the {{ill|Urayasu Sansha Festival|ja|浦安三社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Urayasu Sansha Festival|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, held once every four years. [http://members3.jcom.home.ne.jp/urayasusannjya/]
